name: yespo
description: Yespo's AI agent. Less clicking, more doing.

interface.shortDescription: Yespo's AI agent. Less clicking, more doing.
interface.longDescription: Meet the Yespo Agent: the teammate who never gets tired, never says "I'll circle back," and is suspiciously enthusiastic about doing the boring stuff for you. It helps your team work with Yespo in Codex or Cowork, answer questions, dig things up, and keep workflows moving without turning every task into a small corporate tragedy. Think of it as an extra pair of hands, except faster, calmer, and much better at remembering where things are.
defaultPrompt: Use Yespo to read or update an existing Yespo email message by ID.
Use Yespo to audit my organization's email deliverability technical setup.
Use Yespo to summarize messaging performance for the last 7 days.
